name: Dömsöd (Hungary)
description: Green field with a narrow light grey stripe along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dömsöd: a crowned white shield with a green charge, within a wreath of grapevine.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Dömsöd arms with crown and vine wreath
